name: prepare_session_distill
description: Prepare source-verified review of an existing memory or processing job. Requires target_knowledge from search or an existing distill_job_id. Daily recording and session processing are automatic; this is not a manual remember or batch entry. Default semantic mode checks complete sources; submit reviewed memory_points in finalize without preparing again. include_current returns source-derived relevant current facts with the full source, without changing job ownership; mutually exclusive with current_query. current_query returns all matching current facts in the same packet and resolves their common owner, avoiding a separate search. For a correction, pass target_knowledge from search; its unique current owner is resolved automatically.

project_name.description: Optional context label, not a unique directory identity.

include_current.description: Include related current memories using the complete immutable source text as query. Context only, no exhaustive semantic-match guarantee or automatic owner binding; explicit project scope stays strict.

current_query.description: Topic whose complete current memories should accompany this one prepared session/job; their common owner is resolved, no write implied.

target_knowledge.description: Exact current memories from search to correct; runtime resolves their common write owner. Reuse title, statement, optional module and project_name.

client.description: Transcript source to sync before distill

limit.description: Optional session count to sync before distill; omitted means all matching sessions

full_rescan.description: Ignore sync cursor and rescan matching sessions

scope.description: all: selected device sessions without directory setup; project: explicit source filter.

project_root.description: Optional repository-evidence context; not required for device sessions or verified user statements.

observation_limit.description: Optional observation count; omitted includes all matching observations

run_ingest.description: Run low-level transcript sync before building the packet

distill_job_id.description: Review or resume this exact existing processing job; does not start manual session discovery.

session_id.description: Native source of an explicit correction; use with exact target_knowledge from search.

defer_job_id.description: Failed job to release as retryable and skip for this call.

defer_reason.description: Bounded failure reason stored with defer_job_id.

chunk_limit.description: Optional chunk count for caller-controlled batching; omitted claims all remaining chunks

evidence_mode.description: raw: per-chunk Agent loop. semantic: runtime hash-checks/checkpoints EVERY raw chunk and returns complete parsed exchanges.

detail_level.description: compact: complete exchanges/refs, no duplicate diagnostics. full: include diagnostics.

budget_tokens.description: Advisory diagnostic budget, NEVER a source-reading limit; complete conversation remains returned.

drilldown_exchange_indexes.description: Complete semantic windows at one-based indexes before raw-proof drilldown.

drilldown_chunk_indexes.description: Read-only raw chunk indexes after reviewing, for candidate-grade evidence.

drilldown_query.description: Read-only raw search after reviewing; returns every matching chunk for proof.
